english.title: Operator of aircraft fail to comply with article 43(3) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the operator of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), failed

(A)_[, when the aircraft was weighed, to prepare a weight schedule showing the mass, or such other weight as approved by the CAA for that aircraft]_
(B)_[, when the aircraft was weighed, to prepare a weight schedule showing the position of the centre of gravity at its mass or such other position of the centre of gravity as approved by the CAA for that aircraft]_
(C)_[, when the aircraft was weighed, to prepare a weight schedule showing the mass, or such other weight as approved by the CAA for that aircraft and position of the centre of gravity at its mass or such other position of the centre of gravity as approved by the CAA for that aircraft]_
(D)_[to account for and properly document the accumulated effects of modifications and repairs on the mass and balance of the aircraft]_
(E)_[to make available information relating to the accumulated effects of modifications and repairs on the mass and balance of the aircraft to the pilot in command]_
(F)_[to reweigh the aircraft when the effect of modifications on the mass and balance was not accurately known]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 43(3) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
contravened article 43(3) of the Air Navigation Order 2016

english.notes: (i) Article 43 was amended on Exit Day to exclude weights approved by the EASA - For offences prior to Exit Day, please see offence document H12829.
